IPPT = 3 stations: 1-min push-ups, 1-min sit-ups, 2.4km run. Gold = 85+ total points (Silver 75-84, Pass 51-74), and each station must score at least 1 point. The 19 Feb date is a DEADLINE, not a fixed test day: he can take the official IPPT any day before it, so aim to bank Gold early and keep 19 Feb as a retake buffer. Age group at the TEST DATE determines the scoring table — he turns 28-30 on 19 Feb, so testing BEFORE his birthday may put him in the younger (harder) age band; flag this when scheduling the attempt. Use the official IPPT scoring table for the right age band; never guess point values — if unsure, say so.

Baseline: NOT tested recently. Week of 16-22 Nov is a BASELINE TEST WEEK: max push-ups in 1 min, max sit-ups in 1 min, all-out 2.4km (outdoor track/route, record time). Results are logged in ippt_log.json and drive every later prescription.

Snowboarding prep (beginner): the trip is 20-27 Feb, right after the IPPT deadline, so finish IPPT early and arrive at the trip fresh. Build leg endurance (squats, wall sits, single-leg work, step-downs), core and glute strength, ankle/hip mobility, balance (single-leg, BOSU if available), and wrist/shoulder resilience (push-up work already covers a lot). Falls are inevitable for a beginner — prioritise injury resilience over max strength. Do NOT schedule heavy leg days in the last ~5 days before the official IPPT attempt or the trip; arrive fresh, not sore.

Training-load logic: push-up/sit-up volume is the main driver of IPPT scores — use greasing-the-groove (frequent submaximal sets through the day), density/ladder sessions, and weekly max-rep re-tests. Running: 2.4km-specific work (400m/800m repeats at goal pace, one tempo, easy aerobic runs HR <=135). Keep ~2 hard sessions per week max and never 2 hard days back-to-back.
Gym: Snap Fitness Buangkok (across the road) — available for squats, leg press, core, cable work.
Daily habits: stairs up on return home; push-ups + sit-ups morning routine (now treated as training — count volume).
Shoe rotation: ASICS GEL-KAYANO 31 for easy runs; DYNAFISH XIAONIAN (lightweight) for intervals/time trial/2.4km tests. Xiaonian is already broken in.
Watch: Garmin logs strength_training / hiit / cardio activities — use them (reps/duration/load) for strength-session tracking. IGNORE walking activities (company project, not training).
